shortDescription: Query Patroni REST endpoints for cluster information

options.name: config_path
options.description: Path to the Patroni configuration file (patroni.yml). If specified, the module will parse this file to extract REST API settings. Required if protocol, host, or port are not specified.

options.name: fail_on_error
options.description: If true, the module will fail on connection errors. If false, it will return the error status in the results instead. Useful for health checking and monitoring.

options.name: fetch_config
options.description: If true, the Patroni dynamic configuration is fetched from the server via the C(/config) REST endpoint. The result is returned in the C(config) key.

options.name: host
options.description: Hostname or IP address of the Patroni REST API. If not specified, will be extracted from config_path. Overrides the value from config_path if both are specified.

options.name: mask_credentials
options.description: If true, credentials in the fetched configuration are masked with the value C(REDACTED). Affects C(restapi.authentication.password) and C(postgresql.authentication.*.password). Only applies when O(fetch_config) is true.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the Patroni REST API. If not specified, will be extracted from config_path. Overrides the value from config_path if both are specified.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol to use for the REST API request (http or https). If not specified, will be extracted from config_path. Overrides the value from config_path if both are specified.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for the HTTP request.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when using HTTPS.
